title: Validate/doctor: type vs status mismatch needs remediation hint
description:
Ryan 2026-09-09 dogfood: editorial workflow treats story+open as invalid. Claude created or encountered a story in open status and had no clear remediation path until manually running kbs move to convert it to task.

## Expected

kbs validate or kbs doctor should detect type/status mismatches against the active workflow and print a concrete remediation hint (for example: use kbs move to change type from story to task).

## Observed

Invalid combination is rejected or surfaced without telling the agent what to do next.
